reviews.text: I love this sunscreen. Can be a bit heavy for oily skin type, but it is best to use this sunscreen as a moisturizer. Can leave little white cast on a medium skin tone, but protects very well. Good for being out in the sun for a long time or after a facial treatment.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支防曬。對油性肌嚟講可能會有少少厚重，但當佢係保濕霜用就最好。中等膚色可能會留低少少泛白，但防曬效果好好。適合長時間暴曬或者做完facial之後用。

reviews.text: I absolutely love this facial skincare product! It feels light on the skin, and leaves my face feeling soft and refreshed. After using it regularly, my skin looks healthier and more radiant. Highly recommended for daily use!
reviews.zh: 我絕對鍾意呢支面部護膚品！搽上去感覺輕盈，塊面用完軟軟哋好清爽。持續用完之後，皮膚望落健康咗、更有光澤。非常推薦每日使用！

reviews.text: This mineral sunscreen is fantastic! It does have a slight white cast initially, but it quickly fades as you spread it over your face and let it absorb into your skin.
reviews.zh: 呢支礦物防曬超正！初頭的確有少少泛白，但只要你搽勻塊面等佢吸收，就會好快消退。

reviews.text:
One of my new favorites! I am on my second tube and made sure to pick up multiple. 

As a mineral sunscreen, the white cast was to be expected, but it fades pretty quickly on my light tone skin. The formula isn't drying and it also doesn't feel heavy or make me feel greasy.
reviews.zh:
我最新嘅最愛之一！已經用咗第二支，特登入手多幾支。

作為礦物防曬，泛白係預期之內，但喺我淺色嘅膚色上消退得幾快。配方唔會令皮膚乾燥，亦唔會有厚重感或者油笠感。

reviews.text: These are very moisturizing and nourishing. They’re leave my skin feeling a bit greasy after use so I only use them in the evenings if my skin feels dehydrated. Great fit and quality of material.
reviews.zh: 呢啲好保濕、好滋潤。但用完之後皮膚會有啲油笠嘅感覺，所以淨係夜晚覺得皮膚缺水嘅時候先用。貼合度同物料質素都好好。

reviews.text: One of the better sunscreens for combo/oily skin in terms of the finish - doesn't make you too shiny nor too dry, have a slight brightening effect.
reviews.zh: 以妝效嚟講，係數一數二適合混合性／油性肌嘅防曬——唔會太油光亦唔會太乾，仲有少少提亮效果。

reviews.text:
Application is super smooth and finish is slightly dewy and pretty.
My only issue was at the end of the day the product fades patchy and super noticeable on my light/medium skin, so if you had much lighter skin maybe this wont be an issue
reviews.zh: 上妝超順滑，妝效微微帶水光，好靚。我唯一嘅問題係到咗一日尾，產品會斑駁褪色，喺我呢種偏淺至中等嘅膚色上超明顯，所以如果你膚色再淺啲，可能就唔會有呢個問題

reviews.text:
This is one of my new favorite mineral sunscreen. The sunscreen applies beautifully its leaves some white cast on the sk8n but it goes away pretty quickly.
P.S I have dry skin type and this sunscreen does dry me out it feels very comfortable on my face
reviews.zh: 呢款係我新歡礦物防曬之一。防曬上臉效果好好，會喺皮膚上留少少泛白，但好快就退。P.S. 我係乾性肌，呢款防曬用完真係會抽乾我，但上臉感覺幾舒服

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
